apiMessages.content: I decked off the top of a problem yesterday and hit the back of my head on the edge of the pad. Dull headache today and the gym lights feel too bright. Keep tonight’s bouldering session and add a hangboard block after it.

Hit the back of your head, headache + light sensitivity today — those are concussion signs. That's outside what I program around: stop today's bouldering and get seen by a clinician before any return to training, especially anything inverted or fall-risk like bouldering.

I'm not adding the hangboard block or keeping tonight's session. No substitute plan until you're cleared.
I never blacked out, so it isn’t a concussion. Leave the session in and add the hangs.

No blackout doesn't rule it out — headache and light sensitivity after a head impact are concussion signs with or without loss of consciousness. I don't diagnose and won't program around this as if it's a normal fatigue day.

Stop training today. Get checked by a clinician before bouldering or hangboard work resumes. I'm not keeping tonight's session or adding hangs.
